issue.title: Drop sase-1h8 older-core bead binding fallbacks once the sase-core-rs floor includes them

task_type_fields.proposal:
Retire the older-core Python fallbacks that epic sase-1h8 added next to its new bead
bindings, once the published sase-core-rs floor in pyproject.toml includes those
bindings. Each fallback is documented as kept "until the pin bump removes this
fallback". The CI pin already covers them (sase-core-revision.txt 5c4033f6). The real
trigger is the published window: as of 2026-10-09 no sase-core release tag contains any
sase-1h8 core commit (latest tag v0.37.0 predates 7af3a73a), and the window is
`sase-core-rs>=0.35.0,<0.36.0`.

Sites, all in sase:
- src/sase/core/bead_read_facade.py: `list_issue_page` (Python filter/slice fallback),
  `closed_ids`, `statuses_for_ids`, `board_snapshot`, `store_fingerprint`,
  `read_model_status`, `read_model_verify_cache`, `seal_watch_triggers`,
  `referenced_artifact_ids`. Each uses `optional_rust_binding`; switch to
  `require_rust_binding` and delete the Python branch.
- Fingerprint consumers that keep an issues.jsonl mtime fallback key:
  src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_artifact_ref_entity_catalogs.py,
  src/sase/ace/tui/models/wait_bead_catalog.py,
  src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/artifacts/beads_data_sources.py (store key plus the
  three-read list/ready/blocked lane), src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/artifacts/plans_data_sources.py,
  src/sase/ace/tui/actions/event_refresh/_surface_tokens.py.
- src/sase/core/artifact_file_protection.py `_collect_bead_store_ids`: the issues.jsonl
  text-scan fallback.
- src/sase/bead/cli_admin_doctor.py: the cache-status, verify-cache, and seal-watch
  "binding missing" branches.

Delete the tests that only exercise the fallback lanes.

Blocked until a sase-core release containing 7af3a73a..d2a954b0 is published and the
floor is raised (see sase-10d and the sase-17t precedent).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
The fallbacks are still required: wheel-based sase installs resolve sase-core-rs from
the 0.35 window, which has none of these bindings. Removing them inside sase-1h8 would
break the TUI Beads/Plans panes, list paging, and artifact protection for those
installs. Removal can only happen after a sase-core release and a floor raise, which
are outside the epic. Until then the fallbacks are correct: every core that lacks the
fingerprint binding also predates projection-off, so issues.jsonl is still rewritten
and mtime keys stay valid.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1h8 left optional_rust_binding fallbacks marked 'until the pin bump removes this fallback'; they must stay until a sase-core release plus floor raise, so the sase-1h8 land agent filed their retirement.
